mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction that depresses corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), a supply shock that increases input costs and reduces profit margins causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% over the past three months signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a weakening labor market that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), a dual shock to supply and labor markets causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
